diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..843e0e1 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,16 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  return String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(/\p{M}/gu, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, used) {
+  const taken = new Set(used)
+  if (!taken.has(base)) return base
+  let n = 2
+  while (taken.has(`${base}-${n}`)) n++
+  return `${base}-${n}`
 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass (`# pass 4`, `# fail 0`).

**Changes made:**

1. **`lib/slug.mjs`** — implemented the missing functions:
   - `slugify(input)` — normalizes to NFD and strips combining marks (so `Héllo` → `Hello`), lowercases, replaces any run of non-alphanumerics with a single `-`, and trims leading/trailing dashes.
   - `uniqueSlug(base, used)` — returns `base` if unused, otherwise scans `-2`, `-3`, … for the first suffix not in `used`.

2. **`index.mjs`** — added `uniqueSlug` to the export (the test imports it from the entry point; only `slugify` was exported before).
